description:
About the role:
This is a full-time, in-person (Manchester, UK) position. Compensation will be based on experience and role.
We’re hiring a Full Stack Product Engineer at Byteful, a fast-growing, bootstrapped proxy infrastructure company based in Manchester.
Our residential proxy network powers web scraping, automation and agentic AI companies worldwide. We support thousands of customers across 195+ countries and process 25+ billion proxy requests every month, with 252% year-on-year growth in platform sign-ups. We’ve grown to seven figures in ARR without a sales team. Now we want to go much faster.
You will own the products our customers touch every day. That means the website and dashboard, the mobile and desktop apps, and the growing set of proxy tools around them, from browser extensions to fingerprint testing and automation utilities. You’ll work closely with our designers to turn wireframes and mockups into polished, fast interfaces, and you’ll have a real say in the tools, frameworks and architecture we build them with.
This is a small, high-energy in-person team that moves quickly. Nobody will chase you for progress, and nobody will hand you a finished spec. If you love turning ideas into working products, dig deep into new topics, and take full responsibility for what you ship, we'd like to hear from you.
Responsibilities:
Turn wireframes and mockups from our designers into functional, polished user experiences
Build beautiful, intuitive UX and UI experiences that customers love to use
Improve the performance and UX of our website and dashboard, and ship new features that make the customer experience better
Build and ship cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, from iOS to Windows
Expand our proxy tool ecosystem, including browser extensions, fingerprint testing and automation tools
Own the products you build from planning to production, and deliver features customers rely on
Lead on interface design alongside the team, turning complex workflows into clear, intuitive screens
Drive technical decisions on the tools, frameworks and architecture that keep our products fast and easy to extend
Build product across both backend and frontend, connecting frontend interfaces to robust backend systems
About you:
High energy, high-autonomy and self-motivated
Any experience level welcome. We care more about drive and talent than years in the industry
AI-native. You use AI tools to multiply your productivity and ship faster.
Comfortable owning problems end-to-end, from planning to shipping and production support.
Experience working in a start-up mindset. Comfortable moving fast and learning on the fly.
Requirements, must have:
Experience with Next.js, React and UIkit, and comfort navigating and contributing to large codebases
An eye for design and detail, from layout to micro-interactions
Hands-on experience building against APIs and connecting frontend to backend
Figma fluency. You can take a design file and build it pixel for pixel
Experience with JavaScript, Tailwind CSS and ShadCN components
Experience with Python and PostgreSQL for fullstack development
Something you've built before: a side project, an app, a browser extension or a tool you couldn't find so you made it yourself
Requirements, nice to have:
Experience shipping cross-platform mobile or desktop apps
Experience building browser extensions
Experience working with designers in a small, fast-moving team
Working arrangement:
Full time, in person at our Manchester office
Reporting directly to our founding engineers
Room to grow. You’ll own the products you build from planning to production, and shape the tools and frameworks we use as the team grows
Pay: £36,000.00-£48,000.00 per year
Benefits:
Casual dress
Company pension
Sick pay
Ability to commute/relocate:
Manchester, Greater Manchester: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)
Application question(s):
Please send us your LinkedIn Profile
Work authorisation:
United Kingdom (required)
Work Location: In person

description:
We're looking to add talented Data Infrastructure Engineers to our database for future contract opportunities in Worcester. These roles focus on designing, building and maintaining the data pipelines, infrastructure and systems that enable organisations to make data-driven decisions at scale.
Please note the content of this advert does not represent a live vacancy.
About the opportunity
This is an opportunity to register your interest in future Data Infrastructure Engineer contract roles within the Worcester area. Roles of this type sit at the intersection of data engineering and infrastructure, working to design and optimise the systems, pipelines and platforms that collect, process and deliver data across organisations. You could be working with teams that value technical depth, collaborative problem-solving and a commitment to data quality and reliability.
Typical role overview
Location: Worcester, Worcestershire, England
Type: Contract · Full-time
Rate: £500–650 per day
Domain: Data Infrastructure and Engineering
What you would do
Typical responsibilities could include:
Designing and building robust data pipelines that move data reliably from source systems to analytics and operational platforms
Working with distributed systems, microservices and containerised infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes) to create scalable data solutions
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather data requirements and ensure pipeline alignment with business needs
Implementing and monitoring data quality checks to maintain the integrity and reliability of data flowing through systems
Contributing to infrastructure-as-code practices using tools such as Terraform and managing CI/CD workflows
Supporting integration across cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and on-premises systems
Writing efficient code in languages such as Python, Java, SQL or Bash to transform and move data
Troubleshooting data pipeline failures and optimising performance across the data stack
What you could bring
Most roles of this type require the following:
Must-have
Demonstrable experience designing and building data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (Python, Java, or similar)
Solid understanding of distributed systems, APIs and microservices architecture
Experience with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) or equivalent infrastructure tooling
Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP)
Knowledge of data quality principles and practices
Ability to engage with non-technical stakeholders to understand data requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field
Nice-to-have
Master's degree
Google Cloud Data Engineer certification
Experience with SAP systems (SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, RISE)
Familiarity with .NET/ASP.NET, Spring Boot or similar enterprise frameworks
Knowledge of BPMN, UML or data modelling standards
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform)
Exposure to power BI or similar analytics platforms
What roles of this type could offer
Most roles of this type offer the following, dependent on the industry and seniority of the role:
Opportunity to work on data systems that directly support business intelligence and decision-making
Exposure to modern data stack technologies and cloud-native architecture
Contract flexibility and the chance to work across different organisations and domains
Potential to develop specialist expertise in data infrastructure and pipeline optimisation
Collaborative environments where technical problem-solving is valued
Competitive daily rate of £500–650, reflecting experience and expertise
About SThree
SThree is the global STEM workforce consultancy.
We advise businesses, build expert teams and deliver project solutions to outpace tomorrow, together.
Across the UK, we connect talented specialists with cutting-edge opportunities across technology, engineering, life sciences and financial services supported by our offices in London, Birmingham, Manchester, Glasgow and Leeds
How to register interest
If you are interested in being added to our database to be considered for future opportunities, registering is quick and easy. No cover letter required. We will be in touch when we are instructed on these roles to discuss the next step in your career.

description:
White Collar Factory (95009), United Kingdom, London, London
Software Engineering Manager
About this role
Capital One is looking for a Software Engineering Manager to join us in our London office. You will have previous experience of leading a Software Engineering team and be passionate about people and technical leadership.
What you’ll do
Be a differential people leader. Literally. We expect you to coach and nurture your engineers and make a material positive difference to their careers and impact on the business.
Bring technical leadership to your team. We don’t require you to code, but we do expect you to stay close to your team’s work, set a high bar for engineering, understand technical risks and influence architectural thinking and decisions.
Bring context and purpose to your team. You will ensure your team understands the why behind the work they do, and you will be intentional about how you own and shape culture.
Own ways of working and deliveries, partnering with your Product Owner and Change Delivery Lead to shape roadmaps and lead frequent delivery of high quality software in a complex regulatory environment
Own one or more business applications, keeping them well-managed and compliant with the high bar set by the business
Be a manager for the business, elevating your thinking beyond your immediate team. You’ll represent the interests and context of the business to your engineers, and help make the environment beyond your immediate team a better place.
What we’re looking for
An approachable and inquisitive problem-solving leader, with a focus on the why, and a passion for growing people, nurturing culture and leading technical delivery to help us get things done and make things better in a complex, regulatory environment.
We are looking for:
Previous experience in leading teams, growing engineers and dealing with conflict, constructively and collaboratively
Previous experience of having been an experienced software engineer, and somebody who remains comfortable with technology, architectural decisions and technical trade-offs
Previous experience in our backend tech stack - Java, Spring, AWS and who is a strong advocate of tight feedback loops through mechanisms including, but not limited to automated tests, CI/CD pipelines and frequent releases
A balance of self-reflection and bias for action
Strong ownership and excellent communication
A drive for positive, proactive impact
We understand that great engineering managers may not have everything listed here, and that is OK. If you believe you can make a difference, lead a happy & high-performing engineering team and you have the drive to make a positive impact on the business, we’d love to hear from you.
What’s in it for you:
A people and technical leadership role in an engineering organisation that actively values excellence and doing the right thing, in a business that cares for its associates and has interesting problems to solve around growth, security, availability and performance in a highly regulated space.
A learning environment with access to many excellent resources including online technical courses and in-person leadership training
A competitive salary and immediate access to core benefits including salary sacrifice pension scheme with up to 10% company contribution, bonus, generous holiday entitlement, private medical insurance and flexible benefits including season ticket loans, cycle to work scheme and enhanced parental leave
Open-plan workspace and facilities designed to inspire and support you. In our (quite beautiful) London office, you can heighten your mood with a run on our rooftop running track or an espresso at the Workshop Coffee café
What you’ll get to learn (any previous experience would be advantageous)
Solve real world problems, navigate ambiguity and deliver on the public cloud (AWS) to drive growth and operational efficiencies in an ambitious and growing UK business
Influence change in a complex regulated environment
Where and how you'll work
This is a permanent position based in our London office.
We have a hybrid working model which gives you flexibility to work from our offices and from home.
We’re big on collaboration and connection, so you’ll be based in our London office 3 days a week on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.
What you should know about how we recruit
We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible. And we offer benefits that attract people at all ages and stages.
We also partner with organisations including the Women in Finance and Race At Work Charters, Stonewall and upReach to find people from every walk of life and help them thrive with us. We have a whole host of internal networks and support groups you could be involved in, to name a few:
REACH – Race Equality and Culture Heritage group focuses on representation, retention and engagement for associates from minority ethnic groups and allies
OutFront – to provide LGBTQ+ support for all associates
Mind Your Mind – signposting support and promoting positive mental wellbeing for all
Women in Tech – promoting an inclusive environment in tech
EmpowHER - network of female associates and allies focusing on developing future leaders, particularly for female talent in our industry
Enabled - focused on supporting associates with disabilities and neurodiversity
Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.
If you require a reasonable adjustment, please contact ukrecruitment@capitalone.com All information will be kept confidential and will only be used for the purpose of applying a reasonable adjustment.
For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com
Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.
Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).
Who We Are
At Capital One, we're building a leading information-based technology company. Still founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We are succeeding because they are succeeding.
Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams. Together, we are on a quest to change banking for good.

description:
Architect the platform that runs home life.
We're hiring a Lead Backend Engineer to design a global, agentic-first platform for moving and home life. Fast enough for live voice. Reliable enough for agents to act on their own.
4M+ home movers a year in the UK · 28M UK households to run · $1T+ global market for home services
We are looking for a truly world-class engineer who has seen what great looks like and can take ownership to build the foundations for a global agentic marketplace.
The opportunity: OpenClaw meets Amazon, for your home.
Moving is the second most stressful thing most people do, and the admin never stops. Jay is the personal AI that takes it off your plate. It sets the household up: energy, broadband, water, council tax, insurance and so much more, then keeps it running. It tracks renewals, finds the next deal, and grows with the customer from first rental to first mortgage, with credit and higher-value financial products next. People get back their time, save money and their peace of mind.
Underneath Jay is the platform you'd architect. One side plugs into the property industry: letting agents, CRMs like Alto, deposit schemes, partners like OpenRent and IKEA UK, and the systems that already know someone is moving. The other plugs into hundreds of suppliers across every category a home needs.
In the middle, one entity model and one API turn a move into services set up, switched and paid for, Stripe-like. UK first, then the world.
Nobody has rebuilt this industry for AI. The comparison sites and incumbents still run on forms and call queues. The backend is where that changes.
What you'll own: three things, end to end.
The architecture. Households, properties, partners, suppliers and how they relate. State machines every order runs on, clear enough for an agent to act on. Contracts between domains, data, queues, infrastructure. You design it and you build it.
Speed and reliability, designed in. Live voice needs sub-second reads and a platform that doesn't need babysitting. Latency budgets per domain, observability shipped with the feature, rollback rehearsed every release, small changes to production daily. You'll move live systems onto a modern stack without dropping anything.
Agents as first-class customers. Permissioned access for Jay and partner agents to read and act, with idempotency, audit trails and a hard line around money. Config over code, so commercial teams change pricing without a deploy. How you work becomes how engineering works.
How we build: a lead owns the outcome.
Whatever stands between us and it is yours to clear. How we get there is written down, twelve principles in three parts:
Think: Customer obsessed · AI native · Thinks big · Mission before self
Build: Master of craft · Bias for action · Delivers outcomes · Builds out loud
Together: True ownership · Trustworthy · Seeks and gives feedback · Inspiring to work with
Who thrives here: you should apply if
You're a systems thinker first. How the parts interact, where failure hides, what breaks at ten times the volume.
You've architected real systems end to end, more than once, and run them in production at the scale of millions of users.
You take the edges seriously. Retries, idempotency, backpressure, the message that arrives twice.
You raise everyone around you. The standard goes up on work you never touch. You are great to work with and will make work more joyful.
You're AI-native at the frontier, and you set the practice for the team, from planning to evals.
You're strong in TypeScript, productive in whatever a problem needs within days, and happiest thinking out loud with the team.
Bonus points
You've led a team, or worked in UK property or utilities.
You've moved house in the UK and it made you angry. We want the specific story.
You already have ideas about how it should work. Bring them to the first call.
The team and the stack: who you'd build with.
We're a B Corp, so the values are real. We're FCA regulated, so doing things properly in a regulated industry is part of how we build. And we're obsessed with the customer, which is how we hold 4.9 on both Trustpilot and Google.
The stack: TypeScript on the backend, Python and FastAPI for Jay, Next.js up front, AWS underneath, Claude Code woven through how we build. You won't have used all of it, and you'll change some of it.
The details
Location: London, a few days a week in the office Pay: Cash competitive, plus equity Hours: Work hard, play hard. Crunch time means late nights and weekends. In general, great work-life balance. Reports to: Head of AI and Engineering Right to work: UK right to work required
Work Location: Hybrid remote in London

description:
Research & Development · London · Hybrid
Senior Software Architect
Work on innovative technology at scale and help redefine how people and devices connect globally.
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
Responsibilities
As a Senior Software Architect at TeamViewer, you will shape the architectural direction of scalable, secure, and high-performing software solutions that support our strategic goals. This is a hands-on architecture role requiring strong engineering judgement, technical credibility, and the ability to guide teams through complex design and delivery challenges. You will work closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to make pragmatic architectural decisions, improve system quality, and support long-term maintainability. You will also bring an AI-aware and forward-looking mindset, recognizing where modern AI capabilities, automation, and agentic workflows can improve product capability, developer productivity, operational efficiency, and customer value.
Your primary responsibilities will include:
Hands-On Architecture: Actively contribute to the design and development of enterprise-grade software solutions that are scalable, secure, cost-effective, and maintainable.
Implementation Support: Work closely with development teams, offering practical, hands-on guidance throughout the full software lifecycle — from concept to deployment.
Architectural Strategy: Define and evolve software architecture strategies that align with business goals, product direction, and engineering standards.
Concept and Design Reviews: Conduct detailed reviews of architectural concepts, providing feedback and suggestions to enhance design quality and system performance.
Technical Guidance: Lead technical discussions, mentor senior engineers and architects, and provide practical advice on complex technical challenges.
AI-Aware Architecture and Engineering: Apply strong architectural judgement while recognising where AI, automation, agents, and intelligent workflows can pragmatically improve product capability, developer productivity, operational efficiency, and customer value.
AI-Enabled Developer Productivity: Use and promote AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools to improve development workflows, code quality, refactoring, testing, and team effectiveness.
Practical AI Engineering Awareness: Stay current with relevant AI engineering practices, including concepts such as context windows, custom instructions, agentic workflows, tool use, prompt strategies, model selection, and safe enterprise adoption.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, product, operations, and support teams to ensure architectural alignment and successful delivery across relevant product and platform areas.
Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive architectural documentation that is clear, concise, and accessible to all relevant stakeholders.
Continuous Learning: Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, applying this knowledge to enhance our software architecture.
Risk Management: Identify and document potential risks in the architecture, providing strategies to mitigate them effectively.
Requirements
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and evolving complex software architectures across multiple domains.
Proven ability to deliver hands-on, real-world solutions, actively supporting implementation, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making.
Strong understanding of designing enterprise-grade systems that are scalable, secure, cost-conscious, and maintainable.
Strong expertise in at least one modern back-end programming language, such as C#, Java, or C++, with the ability and willingness to learn new technologies as needed.
Solid experience with data systems, including SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, performance considerations, and operational behaviour at scale.
Practical awareness of how modern AI capabilities can be applied in software engineering and product architecture, while remaining anchored in maintainability, security, scalability, and business value.
Regular hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, with an understanding of how to use them effectively in real engineering workflows.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, multi-platform development, non-functional requirements, and requirements engineering.
Ability to document complex technical systems and concepts in a structured, accessible, and standardized manner.
A pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines.
What we offer
Onsite Onboarding in our HQ office for an optimal start
Great compensation and benefits packages including company achievement bonus and regular salary reviews
Premiums for the private pension plan ( BAV ) up to the maximum amount are topped up by TeamViewer
Public transport friendly offices
Special terms for local gyms
Access to Corporate Benefits platform with many discounts
Regular Team events and company-wide celebrations
Open door policy, no dress code rules, frequent all Hands and Leadership Lunches
Hybrid and Flexible work time
Work From Abroad Program allowing up to 40 days of work outside your contracting country
We celebrate diversity as one of core values, join and drive one of the c-a-r-e initiatives together with us!
TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.
If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

description:
We are looking for a Lead Platform Engineer to join our AI Platform Enablement team, leading the design and delivery of secure, scalable Amazon Connect platform services that enable high-quality customer contact experiences across Pensions & Savings.
Job Type: Permanent
Location: Hybrid: can be based at any of our UK offices Birmingham, London, Telford, Edinburgh with time spent working in the office and at home
Flexible working: All roles are open to part-time, job-share and other types of flexibility. We will discuss what is important to you and balancing this with business requirements during the recruitment process. You can read more about flexible working here.
Closing Date: 15th October
Salary and benefits: from £75,000 (dependant upon experience) plus an indicative bonus range of 16-32%, private medical cover, 38 days annual leave, excellent pension, 12x salary life assurance, career breaks, income protection, 3x volunteering days and much more.
Who are we?
We're Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone's journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we've been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures.
Life today is increasingly complicated, uncertain and unpredictable. People move through different careers, face unexpected moments and navigate important choices. We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters - so you can bring your best, every day.
The role
This is a senior, hands-on engineering role responsible for shaping and evolving the Amazon Connect platform capabilities that underpin customer contact services across Pensions & Savings. You will lead technical design and delivery across contact routing, telephony, digital channels, workforce and quality capabilities, integrations, automation and operational tooling. You will create secure, resilient and reusable platform services, drive high-quality engineering, resolve complex technical challenges and mentor engineers. Working with contact-centre product teams, architecture, security, risk, operations and enterprise technology colleagues, you will ensure the platform balances customer and colleague experience, regulatory obligations, resilience, change velocity and cost.
What you will do
Lead the design, build and evolution of secure, scalable and reusable Amazon Connect platform services across voice and digital channels
Engineer integrations with CRM, identity, data, payment, case-management and workforce systems using AWS services, APIs and event-driven patterns
Create reusable infrastructure-as-code, automated provisioning, testing and CI/CD patterns using Terraform, AWS Cloud Development Kit and GitHub
Embed security, compliance, resilience, observability and cost control into platform design, delivery and live-service operations
Resolve complex routing, integration and telephony issues, lead technical decisions and support safe migration from legacy contact-centre services
Partner with product, operations, architecture, security and risk teams, while mentoring engineers through review, pairing, documentation and knowledge sharing
What are we looking for?
Significant experience designing, building and operating Amazon Connect or a comparable cloud contact-centre platform in a complex, regulated environment
Deep hands-on knowledge of contact flows, queues, routing, telephony, recording and contact-centre operations across voice and digital channels
Strong AWS integration experience, including services such as Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, Kinesis, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch and IAM
Practical expertise in Terraform or AWS Cloud Development Kit, CI/CD, automated testing and software engineering or scripting
Sound understanding of cloud security, identity, networking, encryption, data protection, observability, operational resilience and FinOps
Ability to lead technical decisions, communicate trade-offs clearly, mentor engineers and collaborate across technology, operations and third-party teams
How will we measure success?
A secure, resilient and scalable Amazon Connect platform that meets agreed availability, voice-quality, performance and compliance expectations
Reliable customer journeys with effective routing, clear operational insight and measurable improvements in contact outcomes
Faster, safer and more repeatable platform change through infrastructure as code, automated testing, CI/CD and robust release controls
Effective adoption of reusable Amazon Connect capabilities, with reduced delivery friction for product and operations teams
Improved operational outcomes through proactive observability, service ownership, rapid incident recovery and reduction of recurring faults
Transparent and optimised Amazon Connect and AWS consumption, balancing customer value, performance and cost
Stronger platform engineering capability through technical leadership, mentoring, documentation and knowledge sharing
We want to hire the whole version of you.
We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels accepted and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If your experience looks different from what we've advertised and you believe that you can bring value to the role, we'd love to hear from you.
If you require any adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know so we can help you to be at your best.
We're reviewing applications as they come in, so apply early to avoid missing out.
To make things easier, you might want to save this advert now, it won't be accessible after the closing date.

White Collar Factory (95009), United Kingdom, London, London

About this role

description:
At Somerset Bridge Group, we're transforming our data platform to create a modern, cloud-based data ecosystem that powers smarter decision-making across the business. The role will also involve implementing data governance and security controls, optimising cloud-based data infrastructure, and supporting both real-time and batch data processing.
Working closely with Data Architects, Analysts, Pricing teams and Technology colleagues, you'll help shape the future of SBG's enterprise data platform, delivering scalable, secure and efficient solutions that support strategic business objectives and regulatory requirements.

Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines using Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory and Delta Lake to support both real-time and batch data processing.
Develop and optimise cloud-based data solutions within Azure, ensuring high performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
Create robust data models and lakehouse architectures to support analytics, reporting and machine learning initiatives.
Automate and monitor data workflows using tools such as Databricks Workflows, Delta Live Tables and Azure Monitor.
Ensure data quality, integrity and governance through effective controls, security standards and regulatory compliance.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Pricing, Underwriting, Data Science and Technology to deliver data-driven business solutions.
Implement data security and governance frameworks, including access controls, data lineage and sensitive data protection.
Drive continuous improvement by adopting new technologies and best practices across the Azure and Databricks ecosystem.
What you'll need:
Strong experience building data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks and Azure Data Lake.
Advanced SQL and Python (PySpark) skills for data transformation, automation and optimisation.
Hands-on experience with Delta Lake, Spark, Databricks Workflows and Structured Streaming.
Knowledge of data warehousing, lakehouse architectures and dimensional modelling.
Experience delivering scalable, high-quality data solutions to support analytics, reporting and machine learning.
Familiarity with real-time data processing, APIs and streaming technologies such as Kafka or Azure Event Hubs.
Experience with CI/CD, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code.
Strong understanding of data governance, security and access controls, including Unity Catalog and Purview.
Experience monitoring, optimising and troubleshooting cloud-based data platforms.
Excellent problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
Collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
Passion for innovation, continuous improvement and emerging data technologies.
Desirable
Experience with Scala.
Exposure to MLOps, feature stores and machine learning platforms.

Hybrid working – 2 days in the office and 3 days working from home
25 days annual leave, rising to 27 days over 2 years’ service and 30 days after 5 years’ service. Plus bank holidays!
Discretionary annual bonus
Pension scheme – 5% employee, 6% employer

Flexi-time
Healthcare Cash Plan – claim cashback on a variety of everyday healthcare costs
Electric vehicle – salary sacrifice scheme
100’s of exclusive retailer discounts
Professional wellbeing, health & fitness app - Wrkit

Religious bank holidays – if you don’t celebrate Christmas and Easter, you can use these annual leave days on other occasions throughout the year.
Life Assurance - 4 times your salary
25% Car Insurance Discount

Cycle to Work Scheme
Employee Referral Scheme
Community support day

Somerset Bridge Group is dedicated to delivering fair products and innovative services in the insurance industry. Reporting to the Head of IT (and then to the Project Manager responsible for each task), the Python Developer will design, develop, test and maintain inhouse applications using PHP, Python in a Windows environment. Problem solving skills, ability to work with system users to resolve design issues, conduct user tests and provide support.
Ability to work well within a team, as well as be self-motivated and able to work independently. You may need to develop junior programmers on an ad-hoc basis.
Ability to work methodically and follow MUJI guidelines to ensure consistency across all assets.
Experience with systems in our landscape is not essential, but could be helpful. (Big Commerce, Pimberly, Shipper HQ, Advanced Commerce, Core+ WMS, Ubuntu and Odoo, Slim4, Xero.)
Education and experience
- 5+ years of professional experience developing Windows desktop applications. 2+ with PHP, Python.

About the role
This is a technical leadership role, helping deliver the modernisation of the technology that lets our community of over a million people take action every day on the issues they care about. Our enterprise scale tools are being re-built into a modern, modular platform and you’ll be joining the team as a leader in this work
You’ll be the second senior engineer on the team, joining as an equal partner to our existing senior engineer. This role requires an experienced technology leader with a proven track record of delivering great product and engineering outcomes — someone who has already shaped product engineering strategy, architected and engineered great products, developed people and teams, and established engineering standards through the delivery of significant projects at this level.
For many years, we have maintained a spectrum of different in-house products and are now building a modular platform, and your experience of leading on projects or products like this will be extremely valuable to us.
AI first development is central to our operational and development model and this role will offer you the opportunity to work with a team who’ve already proven that we can use AI development tools to deliver for our organisation. We’re looking to you to help us explore and achieve even more.
We’re on a mission to create an elegant, stable and highly effective platform that sits at the core of our mission – to make our country a fairer, more respectful, more sustainable place, and we’re excited to learn how you’ll help with this.
You will have real agency and influence within a small, growing team to try new things and contribute to making a real-world impact. You will help deliver our product roadmap and identify areas for technological innovation that will continue an exciting new chapter of 38 Degrees. Day-to-day, we are working out how to deliver cutting-edge software development in the age of AI and we are excited for the successful candidate to be a core part of this process.
This is a rare opportunity to help redesign a tech stack, develop a best practice AI-enabled software development model with the highest technical standards and deliver a sector-leading set of tools for one of the biggest campaigning organisations in the UK.
There are no formal education requirements for this role. As long as you can show us that you have the skills we don’t mind where you got them from! To be successful in your application you must meet the requirements of this role and answer the questions below which are part of the selection criteria. Without completion of this task your application cannot be considered.
Your background and experience
We are looking for someone with experience leading development, teams, products and technical standards – you’ll be adept at setting direction and bringing others with you. You’re someone who’s accountable and takes ownership, delivering what they promise. You’re always striving to improve and effective at motivating others to follow the standards you set. You will have experience developing software using AI tools, and be brimming with ideas about how a small technology team can make the most of tools like Claude Code to multiply our impact and how you’ll use your influence in the team to make that happen.
You’re someone who understands the discipline around leading and maintaining a product, not just working across technologies. You are creative and curious when it comes to solving business problems, comfortable asking users “why” and understanding what they are trying to achieve, and you enjoy collaborating to identify and deliver the best technical solutions. You understand the non-profit campaigning domain we’re operating in, or you’re excited to learn. You demonstrate the specific technical expertise the role requires while also applying product-outcomes-thinking best practice to work effectively with end users.
You are a patient and clear communicator with non-technical stakeholders, and you’re motivated by achieving real lasting business impact and collaboratively solving business problems with users rather than simply delivering requested features. You’re driven by the opportunity to build best-in-class campaign tools and deliver professional, high-quality work that makes our tech products a joy for users and supporters to interact with.
You are flexible, as comfortable responding to short-notice reactive requests and staying cool-headed in a crisis as you are pushing forward longer-term product development work. You’re eagle-eyed when it comes to tackling technical debt and putting effective processes in place to maintain high-quality development. You’ll be keen to play a key part in shaping the culture and professional standards of our team.
And finally – you’ll need a passion for being part of our mission to make the country a fairer, more respectful, more sustainable place, and a hunger to give our supporters the power to help make that happen.

About us
38 Degrees is a community of more than a million people who – in a moment away from their busy days – take small actions on issues they care about, which all add up to something bigger, a movement for a better Britain for everyone who calls our country home.
A Britain where we all get a fair chance in life and where the place we were born, or the area we live in, doesn’t decide that chance. Where we protect our planet and hold those in power to account for doing the same, and where we are treated, and treat one another, with respect.
In the space of a week, millions of supporters could be campaigning on anything from protecting our NHS and stopping cuts to Universal Credit, to saving local green spaces and protecting our democracy.
38 Degrees is fiercely independent. We are primarily funded by small donations from hundreds of thousands of members of the public from all over the UK. This independence means we never have to hold ourselves back from taking on those with power and can truly listen to our supporters.

38 Degrees’ culture is honest, kind, supportive, courageous, and respectful. We move fast, and frequently change plans to respond to events. We work hard but we also have fun.

And thanks to our flexible home working approach and network of offices, we have a staff team that is increasingly based across the UK. A third of us live outside London. description:
Architect the platform that runs home life.
We're hiring a Lead Backend Engineer to design a global, agentic-first platform for moving and home life. Fast enough for live voice. Reliable enough for agents to act on their own.
4M+ home movers a year in the UK · 28M UK households to run · $1T+ global market for home services
We are looking for a truly world-class engineer who has seen what great looks like and can take ownership to build the foundations for a global agentic marketplace.
The opportunity: OpenClaw meets Amazon, for your home.
Moving is the second most stressful thing most people do, and the admin never stops. Jay is the personal AI that takes it off your plate. It sets the household up: energy, broadband, water, council tax, insurance and so much more, then keeps it running. It tracks renewals, finds the next deal, and grows with the customer from first rental to first mortgage, with credit and higher-value financial products next. People get back their time, save money and their peace of mind.
Underneath Jay is the platform you'd architect. One side plugs into the property industry: letting agents, CRMs like Alto, deposit schemes, partners like OpenRent and IKEA UK, and the systems that already know someone is moving. The other plugs into hundreds of suppliers across every category a home needs.
In the middle, one entity model and one API turn a move into services set up, switched and paid for, Stripe-like. UK first, then the world.
Nobody has rebuilt this industry for AI. The comparison sites and incumbents still run on forms and call queues. The backend is where that changes.
What you'll own: three things, end to end.
The architecture. Households, properties, partners, suppliers and how they relate. State machines every order runs on, clear enough for an agent to act on. Contracts between domains, data, queues, infrastructure. You design it and you build it.
Speed and reliability, designed in. Live voice needs sub-second reads and a platform that doesn't need babysitting. Latency budgets per domain, observability shipped with the feature, rollback rehearsed every release, small changes to production daily. You'll move live systems onto a modern stack without dropping anything.
Agents as first-class customers. Permissioned access for Jay and partner agents to read and act, with idempotency, audit trails and a hard line around money. Config over code, so commercial teams change pricing without a deploy. How you work becomes how engineering works.
How we build: a lead owns the outcome.
Whatever stands between us and it is yours to clear. How we get there is written down, twelve principles in three parts:
Think: Customer obsessed · AI native · Thinks big · Mission before self
Build: Master of craft · Bias for action · Delivers outcomes · Builds out loud
Together: True ownership · Trustworthy · Seeks and gives feedback · Inspiring to work with
Who thrives here: you should apply if
You're a systems thinker first. How the parts interact, where failure hides, what breaks at ten times the volume.
You've architected real systems end to end, more than once, and run them in production at the scale of millions of users.
You take the edges seriously. Retries, idempotency, backpressure, the message that arrives twice.
You raise everyone around you. The standard goes up on work you never touch. You are great to work with and will make work more joyful.
You're AI-native at the frontier, and you set the practice for the team, from planning to evals.
You're strong in TypeScript, productive in whatever a problem needs within days, and happiest thinking out loud with the team.
Bonus points
You've led a team, or worked in UK property or utilities.
You've moved house in the UK and it made you angry. We want the specific story.
You already have ideas about how it should work. Bring them to the first call.
The team and the stack: who you'd build with.
We're a B Corp, so the values are real. We're FCA regulated, so doing things properly in a regulated industry is part of how we build. And we're obsessed with the customer, which is how we hold 4.9 on both Trustpilot and Google.
The stack: TypeScript on the backend, Python and FastAPI for Jay, Next.js up front, AWS underneath, Claude Code woven through how we build. You won't have used all of it, and you'll change some of it.
The details
Location: London, a few days a week in the office
Pay: Cash competitive, plus equity
Hours: Work hard, play hard. Crunch time means late nights and weekends. In general, great work-life balance.
Reports to: Head of AI and Engineering Right to work: UK right to work required
Work Location: Hybrid remote in United Kingdom

description:
We are looking for a Lead Platform Engineer to join our AI Platform Enablement team and help build, operate and continuously improve our orchestration and developer experience solutions. This hands-on role will focus on creating secure, automated and repeatable experiences that help engineering teams onboard workloads and make effective use of approved developer tooling.
Job Type: Permanent
Location: Hybrid: based at any of our UK offices Birmingham, London, Telford, Edinburgh with time spent working in the office and at home
Flexible working: All roles are open to part-time, job-share and other types of flexibility. We will discuss what is important to you and balancing this with business requirements during the recruitment process. You can read more about flexible working here.
Closing Date: 15th October
Salary and benefits: from £75,000 (dependant upon experience) plus an indicative bonus range of 16-32%, private medical cover, 38 days annual leave, excellent pension, 12x salary life assurance, career breaks, income protection, 3x volunteering days and much more.
Who are we?
We're Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone's journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we've been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures.
Life today is increasingly complicated, uncertain and unpredictable. People move through different careers, face unexpected moments and navigate important choices. We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters - so you can bring your best, every day.
The role
This senior, hands-on role will shape and operate the orchestration and developer platform solutions supporting our Pensions & Savings technology services. You will lead delivery across developer tooling, automation and reusable workflows-including GitHub, GitHub Copilot, developer portals, artefact and container management, observability and cloud integration-while partnering across application, architecture, security, risk and technology teams to provide secure, governed and scalable developer experiences.
What you will do
Build, operate and continuously improve secure, reliable and reusable internal developer platform capabilities for Pensions & Savings.
Create and evolve golden paths and automated onboarding journeys that help engineering teams onboard new and existing workloads, adopt approved developer tooling and deliver software consistently.
Administer and improve GitHub and GitHub Copilot capabilities, including organisation, team and repository onboarding, access, policies, rulesets and reusable workflows.
Develop robust platform automation using appropriate combinations of GitHub Actions, APIs, infrastructure as code and scripting, replacing manual or inconsistent processes wherever practical.
Support secure artefact and container management, including integration with build and delivery workflows and appropriate controls for access, provenance, retention and vulnerability management.
Contribute to developer portal and self-service capabilities that improve discoverability, documentation, service ownership and access to standard platform journeys.
Embed security, identity, governance, compliance and observability into platform services and onboarding processes, while maintaining the operational health and auditability of enterprise developer tooling.
Partner with application, product, architecture, security, risk and operations teams to resolve complex issues, support effective use of tools such as Jira and Confluence across the software development lifecycle, and improve platform capabilities through documentation, enablement and feedback.
What are we looking for?
Strong hands-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps or developer tooling, with a track record of creating reliable automation, reusable workflows and self-service capabilities.
Practical experience with GitHub and modern software delivery practices, including repositories, access controls, CI/CD and secure development workflows.
A security-first approach to operating enterprise tooling, with a sound understanding of identity and access management, privileged administration, secrets, platform policies and auditability.
Familiarity with internal developer platforms, developer portals and golden-path approaches, together with a practical understanding of cloud environments and related capabilities such as artefact and container management, observability, AI-enabled developer tooling, Jira and Confluence.
The ability to take ownership of complex technical work, make and explain sound engineering decisions, and collaborate effectively with application, architecture, security, risk and operations teams.
How will we measure success?
Secure, reliable and supportable internal developer platform services that meet agreed operational, security and compliance expectations.
Faster, safer and more repeatable workload onboarding through effective golden paths, reusable workflows and automated controls.
Growing adoption of approved developer tooling and self-service capabilities, with reduced developer friction and less reliance on manual intervention.
Improved operational outcomes through effective observability, automation, clear service ownership and the reduction of recurring platform and onboarding issues.
Transparent and responsible consumption of developer tooling and platform services, with decisions balancing developer value, performance, risk and cost.
Stronger platform engineering capability through sound technical leadership, clear documentation, effective enablement and knowledge sharing.
We want to hire the whole version of you.
We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels accepted and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If your experience looks different from what we've advertised and you believe that you can bring value to the role, we'd love to hear from you.
If you require any adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know so we can help you to be at your best.
We're reviewing applications as they come in, so apply early to avoid missing out. #LI-GJ1
title: Lead Platform Engineer

description:
About Us
Humaans is building the next generation of infrastructure for the workplace; software designed for companies that are scaling fast, operating globally, and pushing into new boundaries.
What started as a system of record has evolved into a broader platform for operating people globally. With Athena, our agentic AI layer, Humaans moves beyond data management into intelligent orchestration, connecting workflows across HR, IT, Finance, and Operations so organisations can act faster and with greater confidence, redefining how work gets done.
We work with ambitious teams across Europe and the US, from AI-native companies like Lovable, Poolside, Fyxer AI, and Tandem Health, to established, high-growth organisations scaling internationally and through acquisition, including Quantexa, Sellpy, Manychat, Gigs, Croud, and Threecolts. These teams don’t buy software for features,they buy leverage. The ability to run faster, cleaner, and with more control as complexity compounds.
To date, we’ve raised $20m in venture funding from some of the most respected founders, operators, and funds in technology: Lachy Groom (Physical Intelligence), Stewart Butterfield (Slack), Tobias Lütke (Shopify), Dylan Field (Figma), Jeff Weiner (LinkedIn), Claire Johnson (Stripe), Oliver Jay (OpenAI), Jay Simmons (Bond) as well as Y Combinator, Moonfire, Frontline Ventures, Pathlight Ventures, and Exor.
If you have massive ambition and want to work on a hard problem, with a small team that moves fast, at a moment when the category is genuinely up for grabs - this is it.
Our tech stack
Our tech stack today consists of TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node, Postgres and Redis. We use GitHub for code and continuous integration to deploy to Kubernetes on Google Cloud Platform. We have a public REST API and our browser client uses a realtime WebSocket API. We obsess over details and quality of the user facing features and their implementation. Yet we move fast by creating focus and leveraging high quality foundations.
Your day to day
Help us shape the product from definition to release
Build end to end features, fix bugs, improve infra, support customers
Write backend TypeScript in Node, Postgres, Redis, Kubernetes
Write frontend TypeScript in React
Expand our 3rd party integration marketplace
Contribute to our technical architecture planning
Support sales and marketing teams
Skills
Multiple years of industry experience in a full stack web app development role (ideally in SaaS)
Great knowledge of TypeScript and an appreciation for the language
Appreciation for design and digital product craftsmanship
Experience collaborating directly with product teams and designers, and a proven track record of delivering value to customers or users
This is an in-person role. Our GTM team comes together in the office Monday through Thursday, while most of the team collaborates in person on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays.
Package & Benefits
Early stage startups can be messy – we know that. We're putting effort in providing you with the best employee experience and a quality driven environment in exchange for trusting us.
Market-leading compensation that reflects your value
25 days paid time off each year plus public holidays
Share Options with 5-year exercise window so you don’t feel pressure to exercise if you leave
Free Thursday lunches at HQ, quarterly team events, and company offsites.
Top tier private coverage for health, vision and dental care
A new MacBook and tools you need to do your best work
Enhanced parental leave with up to 16 weeks for primary and 4 weeks for secondary
Learning & development budget
Why Join Humaans Today?
HR tech is having its AI moment and we’re positioned to own it. Humaans started as a next-gen HRIS taking on large incumbents in a massive market. We’ve since evolved into something even bigger: an AI platform that sits across workforce data and automates the operational layer of HR entirely; the natural progression of what we’ve been building toward.
The product is highly differentiated. It’s built around a structured workforce data model that makes AI reliable in an HR context, something no one else has gotten right. Customers notice the difference immediately.
We’re backed by Y Combinator, Lachy Groom, Moonfire, Frontline Ventures, and operators who’ve built some of the most consequential software companies of the last decade: the founders of Slack, Figma, and Shopify, and Asana’s former CRO and Head of OpenAI International.
We’re a small team with an unapologetically high bar. It shows up in the product, in how we communicate, and in the standards we hold each other to.
Our Commitment to Diversity
At Humaans we’re looking for genuinely good people that are transparent and emphatic. We’re committed to providing equal opportunities, a diverse and inclusive work environment, and ensuring a fair interview process for everyone. You’re welcome to apply no matter your gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.
Privacy notice
We care about your privacy. When you apply for a role at Humaans, we’ll collect and process your personal data as part of our recruitment process. This includes things like your CV, contact details, and any other information you choose to share. We may also contact you about future opportunities. You can ask us to delete your data at any time. For more details, see our Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)

description:
Our Story
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com!
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife
The engineering challenge
Our Software Engineers don't just write code, they solve real financial problems for millions of customers. You'll work on distributed systems processing thousands of transactions daily, build resilient services that handle people's money, and create experiences that make traditionally complex financial products feel simple.
Your Impact
You love shipping great products, not just writing superb code
As an Engineer, you’re interested in the problem, not just the requirements
You feel comfortable in a fast-moving environment and are ambitious about the speed and quality of your code. We ship our code multiple times a week with the impact measured in the result for the customer, not lines of code
An advocate of test-driven development or, even better, behaviour-driven development. A strong commitment to quality is essential
You've worked on large scale distributed software systems that have proven scalability and complex topologies
Enjoy talking to key stakeholders and understand and show passion for the business objectives of the company
You are comfortable with a fair bit of uncertainty, fast change, and love solving hard problems collaboratively
You are a team player who thrives working in an honest and friendly working atmosphere. We have a flat hierarchy and give you the opportunity to make a real impact
Your Toolkit
You'll work with Kotlin, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS Aurora Postgres, and other modern technologies. If you haven't worked with all of these, we value skilled engineers with a willingness to learn.
A product-focused engineering mindset
Experience building distributed systems at scale
Test-driven development practices
Comfort operating in uncertainty and rapid change
Collaborative problem-solving skills
Our Engineering Culture
Customer impact over unnecessary complexity
Team success over individual heroics
Operational ownership, not just feature delivery
Continuous improvement through honest feedback
Added Bonus
Experience with fintech or banking is a plus, but we value problem-solvers from all backgrounds
At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.
We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.
You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.
Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice
Diversity Statement
Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.
Our approach to AI in interviews
At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.
Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.
Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.
Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

description:
About the Team
SevenRooms is a hospitality technology platform that powers restaurant operations and marketing, and was recently acquired by DoorDash! The SevenRooms product enables operators to automatically drive revenue & profitability by leveraging data to build direct relationships, deliver exceptional experiences, and increase repeat business. The SevenRooms "In-Store" Technology organization at DoorDash is committed to building products that help restaurants create magical experiences every day. We are a small, but rapidly growing team of 70+ engineers, scientists and builders who are on a mission to fundamentally transform the hospitality industry. Our tech stack includes Python, Typescript, ReactJS, Redux, Django, App Engine, Cloud Firestore, Memcache, Cloud Tasks, Firebase, BigQuery, Elasticsearch, and more.
About the Role
We're looking for a strong Backend-focused Software Engineer who is excited to engineer highly performant, mission-critical systems that are designed for agile development and rapid scaling. You will partner with other engineers, product managers and designers who are dedicated to engineering real solutions that empower our In-Store team for growth. You will be joining an organization of engineering professionals working to fundamentally transform the hospitality industry through innovative technology solutions.
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve software. Focus strongly on customer-facing features that create magical experiences for restaurant partners.
Be the technical owner of features from design to implementation. Take ownership of ongoing support and ensure high-quality delivery throughout the development lifecycle.
Manage individual project priorities, deadlines, code quality and deliverables. Participate in occasional on-call duties to keep software systems up and running smoothly.
Partner with cross-functional teams including engineers, product managers and designers. Collaborate to engineer real solutions that drive growth and innovation in the hospitality industry.
Work with cutting-edge technology stack. Utilize tools like Python, Django, and modern cloud infrastructure to build scalable solutions.
We're excited about you because…
You have a BS degree in Computer Science, similar technical field of study or equivalent professional experience with 3+ years of software engineering experience
You have experience developing web applications with strong knowledge of algorithms, data structures, complexity analysis and software design
You have experience with Python (preferred), or another modern backend technology, and are excited to work with our modern technology stack
You are passionate about building customer-facing features and take ownership of technical solutions from conception to deployment
You thrive in collaborative environments and are excited to work with cross-functional teams to solve complex problems in the hospitality industry

description:

Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. About The Role
Our hubs are in Berlin, London and Tallinn, but we are open to hire remotely from Europe and United Kingdom.
What You’ll Do
Make an impact in a true product team with a large ownership scope.
Work with cutting-edge technologies (Go is the primary language; it’s okay if you’re willing to switch from another language) without a legacy codebase.
Work on improving the reliability of our API.
Deliver fast and often. We embrace an agile methodology with a retrospective and demo at the end of the two-week cycle.
Design, build and own event-driven, fault-tolerant, horizontally scalable distributed systems using a Microservice architecture powered by Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka and PostgreSQL.

Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general.
Experience in event-driven architectures, event streaming, and event sourcing systems.
Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing).

You're excited about fintech and building the financial infrastructure of tomorrow.

You're hungry to learn and eager to grow quickly.

Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions

description:
We're putting together a talented team to build the #1 training platform for Runners
We help everyday runners become outstanding by building an incredible app providing world-class training, coaching and community for everyone, whether you're improving your 5k time or training for your first marathon.
We’re growing extremely fast! In November 2023 we closed a $6.5M funding round led by JamJar with participation from Eka Ventures, Venrex and Creator Ventures. In 2024, we were selected by Apple as one of three global finalists for the iPhone app of the year, reflecting the innovation and impact of what we’ve built & in 2025 we were acquired by Strava!
Our ambition is huge: to become the go-to global leading training platform for millions of runners everywhere. We’re growing with purpose and looking for people who want to build something meaningful with lasting impact. With the recent acquisition by Strava accelerating our journey, now is a really magical time to join. 🚀
Who we're looking for
We're looking for a talented, high-quality full-stack engineer to join our team.
We care about how well you build software, how you work within a team, and how fast you learn. Runna's stack and problems will keep changing as we grow, so we're looking for strong engineers who pick up new systems quickly and bring good judgement wherever they land, not a checklist match against today's tech.
You'll work closely with your Engineering Manager and a cross-functional squad - product, design and fellow engineers - as well as colleagues across Strava. Wherever you land, the goal is the same: helping Runna become the most trusted training platform for runners everywhere.
We follow a flexible hybrid model that translates to more than half of your time on-site - 3 days per week in Runna's office based in London, UK.
What you'll be doing
Architect, build, test and deliver features and reliability improvements across the full stack, from our mobile apps through to the systems behind them
Take ownership of problems end-to-end, from design through build, release, testing and support
Work closely with Product and Design to find the most reliable and intuitive solution to the problem in front of you
Help evolve our developer tooling, CI/CD pipeline and engineering standards, and take your turn in the team's release rotation
Be on hand to support teammates on tricky technical problems, wherever they sit in the stack
As you settle in, you'll could dig into things like our recording and sync pipeline, third-party wearable integrations, or interfacing with modelling engineers on plan adaptations - the specifics will evolve with our roadmap and your strengths, so treat this as a flavour of the work rather than a fixed brief
Requirements
If you don't tick every box below, please apply anyway. Research shows that strong candidates can rule themselves out over a partial match even when they'd do the job well. If you're a strong full-stack engineer keen to learn, we'd rather hear from you than not, and we're happy to talk about whether a different role or level might be a better fit.
What you’ll bring
You're a strong full-stack engineer (frontend or backend-leaning is fine) with a track record of shipping features end-to-end
You pick up new languages, frameworks and systems quickly, and you're comfortable working outside your current comfort zone as our roadmap evolves
You care about the craft, writing readable and well-tested code, and have good judgement about when to move fast and when to slow down
You enjoy working closely with product, design and other engineers to find the best solution to a problem, not just the most technically interesting one
You take the initiative and look to impact beyond your immediate team, such as improving developer experience or AI-enablement
Our stack today
We hire for general strength, not stack familiarity - most of our engineers joined without prior experience in one or more of the above, and we'll get you fully ramped up during onboarding.
Frontend: React Native, TypeScript, GraphQL
Backend: serverless on AWS, Node.js/Python, DynamoDB, Snowflake
Tooling (continuously re-evaluated): Claude Code, Cursor, Linear with agents, Github with GHA
Nice to have, not required
Experience with native mobile development (Swift, Kotlin, SwiftUI, watchOS) - useful given how close some of our hardest problems sit to the OS, but not a dealbreaker if you don't have it yet
Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation) or serverless architectures
Open-source contributions, big or small
A strong interest in health or fitness technology
Salary And Benefits
We’re offering a salary of £85,000-95,000 per year, depending on experience, plus participation in Strava's long-term incentive (stock) programs. Overview of our benefits is below:
We’re also committed to continually evolving our benefits to support you as we grow. Here is a brief overview what we currently offer in the UK 🇬🇧
🏢 Flexible working – we typically spend 3 days a week together in our Vauxhall office
🏝️ 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays
📱Free Runna & Strava subscriptions for you and 3 of your friends (get ready to be your friends fave person or save them for holiday presents!)
🧘 Headspace membership
💸 Money every year to spend on gear, events and the gym!
🏥 Private health insurance with Bupa and workplace pension scheme
💖Modern Health is a mental wellness platform and app that combines technology with professional support to improve mental well-being and reduce stress

Please see more info on our amazing benefits here: Benefits at Runna

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?
Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.
About The Advanced Technology Group
The Advanced Technology Group (ATG) is a part of Foundational Systems and Experiences Engineering (FSEE) within the Platform Business Group. Established over 20 years ago as part of PlayStation®’s first-party game development studios, ATG has always focused on helping game developers get the most out of PlayStation® hardware - a mission that continues to this day. As a team, we are responsible for large parts of the graphics software stack used by all PlayStation® games, and collaborate with leading engineering teams worldwide, from game developers to hardware vendors, to deliver key platform technologies.
What You’ll Be Doing
You will be working on the current and future rendering APIs used by PlayStation games, as well as the hardware underpinning them.
You will design and implement features that enable efficient game development, push GPU programming forward, and create a healthy platform.
You will observe industry trends, understanding of – and empathy for – our customers, and business needs as the foundation of your decision making.
You will help shape the path of the PlayStation graphics stack going forward.
You will collaborate with the platform software and hardware teams, as well as game developers.
You will often take the role as the game-developer advocate when working with the platform teams, or the role as the platform-team advocate when working with game developers.
This is a senior position at the core of PlayStation GPU technology with an unusual degree of influence on future of console graphics-programming. ATG is granted a high degree of trust and autonomy in shaping the graphics software stack and we are looking for people who are passionate about carrying this forward. You will not be spending your time in committee meetings or writing endless proposals, this is very much an engineering role where your primary role is to determine what needs to be implemented, how best to implement it and to then sit down, code, debug. We believe that this practical focus is crucial in building up the skill, experience, and insight required to make the large-scale and long-term decisions we have been entrusted with.

Experience and interest in low-level graphics architecture and engineering.
Experience writing rendering code on top of multiple existing rendering APIs.
Experience writing rendering code on console.
The ability to keep an eye on the big picture, even when deep in the weeds.
An eagerness to learn and to take responsibility for the long run.
